title: Rejoining Kirby at the Copacabana: a lesser band
summary: He rejoined Kirby at the Copacabana after Nat Cole, finding Bill Beason, Hank Jones, Buster Bailey and Freddy Webster, but without the original sound.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: So it was at the Copacabana where I joined Kirby.
When I rejoined him, yes. And we followed Nat Cole and --
What shape did you find the Kirby band in when you came out? Who was with it? Had he kept it going in the two years?

He kept it going, but it wasn't -- it wasn't -- it wasn't. He had a -- he had Bill Beason on drums, Hank Jones on piano. I mean these are good musicians, but they weren't getting the, you know, original sound or the original --
Yes. Yes. And he had a trumpet player who has since died. His name was Freddy Webster.
Freddy Webster, which was a very good -- he was a very good trumpet player, but he went the way those young be-boppers were going then, you know.
Oh, that's right, you mentioned Hank Jones.
Yes. Now, be-bop wasn't really -- I guess it was just, '45 it was just coming in.
